name: wps-cloud-bridge
description: Template package for a hosted ChatGPT connector to WPS cloud documents. Configure an authorized MCP endpoint before use.

interface.longDescription: Find, read, create, and edit supported personal WPS cloud documents from a ChatGPT conversation. The hosted service returns WPS links and checks results after writes. This independent package is a template and requires an authorized MCP endpoint; it is not a public Directory release.
defaultPrompt: Find my recent WPS cloud documents.
Create a Word document about tea tasting and return its WPS link.
